title: IANA IEEE 802 Numbers — historical EtherType and IEEE 802 parameter tables

date.notes: Live informational registry viewed during the August 2026 excavation.

claims_extracted.claim: The informational table records 0x0800 for IPv4, 0x0806 for ARP and 0x86DD for IPv6 among historical/current EtherType values.
The table preserves historical/transition notes such as old Xerox experimental protocol-number values and later standardized replacements.

notes: IANA's page is informational for IEEE-assigned EtherTypes; assignment authority belongs to the IEEE Registration Authority.
